rules.accepted_credit_types: Up to 5 h any AAVSB RACE-approved offering; min 10 contact hours (interactive distance, seminar/lecture, lab; live-streamed and online interactive must be RACE-approved); USDA accreditation modules count as online contact hours; other Board-approved offerings
rules.new_licensee_rule: Veterinarians who graduated in the prior year renew without CE proof.
rules.alternatives: Veterinarians who turned 70 before Sept 1, 2025 are exempt; Board may excuse for good cause, sickness or emergency (letter before Aug 1).
rules.notes: Annual license expires August 1; hours earned Aug 1 - Aug 1 (CE up to 15 days before the period may count). Proof of attendance must be submitted. A new Practice Act took effect July 1, 2026.
rules.legal_basis: 30 Miss. Admin. Code Pt. 1701, R. 2.12; Miss. Code Ann. §73-39-75
